30Visum est (ut affine huic argumento) ex Archiis addi: Fidelitatis quandam formulam, quam ante octennium scripto conceptam Sacerdotes è Pontificiis Saeculares, in obsequij fidei, siue autoramentum erga eandem Regina Elizabetha Maiestatem, subscripta manu frequentes sunt professi. pag.203.

page.notes: The line numbers 5 to 30 are printed in the right margin. Their exact positions are approximate: 5 stands by the top ornament, 10 by line one, 15, 20, 25 and 30 at the matching lines. The paragraph after the rule is set in the same italic type as the entries above it, so it is transcribed as a main-text paragraph and not as a footnote. Uncertain readings: "proxime" (possibly "proximæ" or similar, the letters are blurred), "Saeculares" (the letters are faint). Spelling of i/j and u/v follows the house rules, so "jusiu-randum", "juramenti" and "civilem" are normalised. The woodcut and the top ornament contain no text.
